title: Mini Golf
author: cobanov
description: Two courses of nine hand-made minigolf holes with ramps, bowls, bumpers, water, spinners and a windmill: line up the putt with the preview, time the power meter and sink every hole under par.

controls.D-pad: Aim (LEFT / RIGHT turn, UP / DOWN fine-tune) / choose in menus
controls.A: Hold to charge, release to putt / select / skip the intro / next hole
controls.X: Switch the power range: full or short putt
